description: TKN holders burn tokens through the Monolith TKN token contract for a pro-rata share of ETH in Token Holder.

meta.note: Per-entry ETH is what burn(balance) pays at the snapshot block: balance x holder ETH / totalSupply(). TKN balances sum to more than totalSupply(), so the listing is first-come-first-served and its total exceeds the Holder's ETH.
